name: Champions' Hall
summary: In Stormwind's Old Town, Champions' Hall is guarded and reserved for Alliance officers. Its quartermasters supply weapons, armor, and regalia to veterans who have proven themselves in battle.

sections.title: The Alliance Officer's Barracks
sections.body: Champions' Hall stands behind a guarded entrance in Old Town, reserved for the Alliance's distinguished combatants. Military commanders gather around maps of Azeroth to discuss ongoing campaigns, among arms and the insignias of rank. Only Alliance soldiers who have earned the rank of Knight or higher may enter. Inside, quartermasters supply battle-hardened soldiers with elite weapons, armor, and mounts made to aid them against the Horde in contested lands.

faq.q: Where is the Champions' Hall located?
faq.answer: Champions' Hall lies in southern Old Town in Stormwind City, behind a guarded entrance.

faq.q: Who is allowed inside the Champions' Hall?
aliases: why cant i enter champions hall
faq.answer: Alliance soldiers who have earned the rank of Knight or higher in battle may enter Champions' Hall. Recruits without that standing and civilians are turned away.

faq.q: What is inside the Champions' Hall?
aliases: what vendors are in champions hall
faq.answer: Quartermasters inside offer officer-tier weapons, armor, insignia, and specialized war mounts. Alliance tacticians and generals gather around tables covered with maps of Azeroth.

faq.q: What is the Horde equivalent of this building?
faq.answer: The Horde counterpart is the Hall of Legends in Orgrimmar, where decorated Horde warriors receive the same military supplies.

angles.text: For the Alliance, Champions' Hall honors those in Stormwind who devote their lives to repelling Horde incursions.
As a warrior on the front lines, you can look to Champions' Hall for heavy battle gear and arms reserved for proven battlefield leaders.
